messages:
Maya (CS): Morning async — quick standup. What I did: followed up with AsterTech on their renewal contract and triaged webhook delivery failures. Blockers: webhook retries still failing for ~10% of events, customers seeing duplicates; need eng help to check idempotency + retry behavior. Today: coordinate hotfix + customer comms.
Jon (Eng): saw the overnight alert, starting on webhook worker logs now. Suspect a retry storm from persistent 429s hitting the upstream. Can you drop sample event IDs and a screenshot? @Maya (CS)
Maya (CS): sample IDs: `evt_7f8c9a`, `evt_7f8d02`, `evt_7f8f11`. Screenshot uploaded to the thread. AsterTech legal is asking for an ETA on fix for their renewal decision — need an estimate to pass along.
Noah (SRE): I'll check rate limits + ingress LB metrics. If it's retries, we can enable a temporary circuit breaker that rejects excess attempts (429 -> 503 backoff) to reduce storm. Ping me once Jon has a root cause.
Jon (Eng): FYI there's an almost-ready PR that adds idempotency token handling to the webhook worker: `github.com/redwood/webhooks/pull/412`. I can fast-track a small patch if CI passes. @Alyssa (CS Manager) — need permission to expedite.
Alyssa (CS Manager): OK to fast-track if we include a minimal smoke test and a rollback plan. Also CS should prepare a short mitigation note customers can apply (e.g., enable client side backoff or idempotency header).
Priya (CS): I can draft the customer-facing note with mitigation steps + ETA placeholder (I'll use 2–4 hrs once patch is deployed). Maya, I'll own the AsterTech update.
Jon (Eng): running unit + integration tests now, then a small staging canary. If tests pass, estimate ~90m to production canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy started — staging webhook-fix canary (run id: canary-7889). Logs: tail -f /var/log/webhook-canary.log
Maya (CS): holding comms to AsterTech until canary looks stable. Legal wants a firm ETA; I will give the 2–4 hr window and promise an update after canary. :thumbsup: 
Noah (SRE): applied a temporary ingress throttle (10m window) to dampen retries. Monitoring in place; will revert after prod canary is healthy.
Jon (Eng): staging canary shows no duplicates and retry rate dropped. Preparing prod canary rollout in ~20m, will ping when started. @Priya please stand by for release note snapshot.
Maya (CS): great — once prod canary clears I'll send the update to AsterTech and include the mitigation steps. Small ask: can we add a dashboard widget for webhook error rate by customer? Not blocking renewal but would help CS triage future incidents.
Jon (Eng): opened ticket `WEB-990` to track the dashboard widget. Will triage for next sprint unless CS wants to prioritize it now.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone — I'll update the AsterTech contact after prod canary completes. Ending async.
